operations.title: The Saturated Rees Cone Is the Canonical 45-Divisor Principal-Parts Module
The supported cone of the saturated Rees map is exactly the 45 marked principal-parts module
operations.summary: Each reciprocal normal block fits 0->O->O(D)->O_D(D)->0. Five edge blocks become trivial residues, while ten boundary-pair blocks carry inflated regular C2^2 packets, totaling 15 trivial, four of each singleton, and one of each pair character. No new support or character appears.
